final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON ma.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(player_id) AS player_count FROM step1 GROUP BY bats), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total FROM step2) SELECT step2.bats, step2.player_count, CAST(step2.player_count AS REAL) / step3.total FROM step2 JOIN step3 ON step3.total IS NOT NULL
